title: We will bring back subsidy after removing corruption — Obi at Sokoto town hall
summary: At the Obi/Kwankwaso NDC town hall in Sokoto, Peter Obi said Nigeria’s problem is corruption, not subsidy itself. Stop the leakages first, then subsidy can return. Education after unity and security; connect state capitals by rail.

title: We won’t bribe voters or party agents — Obi after Sultan visit
summary: After visiting the Sultan of Sokoto with Rabiu Kwankwaso, Peter Obi told the town hall NDC will not give money to agents to induce voters. Vote-buying, he said, is part of why poverty persists. Votes must be counted and protected.

title: Obi and Kwankwaso visit the Sultan of Sokoto; monarch plays fatherly role
summary: NDC presidential and vice-presidential candidates Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso, with Sokoto governorship candidate Dr Shamsu Haido, paid a courtesy visit to Sultan Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar. The Sultan urged peaceful, respectful campaigns and national unity.

title: 2027: Peter Obi blames APC for rising poverty, outlines rail and farm plan in Sokoto
summary: At the Sokoto NDC town hall, Obi blamed the ruling party for worsening poverty and insecurity, pledged rail links for Sokoto, Kebbi and Zamfara, fertiliser support for farmers, and a presidency where Obi and Kwankwaso work as one team.

title: Obi and Kwankwaso seen at Nnamdi Azikiwe Airport, Abuja, heading to next engagement
summary: Monday morning photos of NDC presidential and vice-presidential candidates Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso at Nnamdi Azikiwe International Airport, Abuja, as they set out for their next engagement. The ticket is visibly on the road.

title: 2027: Tinubu’s govt doing everything to stop me — Peter Obi
summary: At Madonna University, Okija, Peter Obi told students the Federal Government is trying to keep him off the 2027 ballot and that they will fail. He urged them to obtain PVCs and vote competence, not tribe.

title: Scrutinise politicians’ records before elections, Obi urges editors
summary: After the Guild of Editors conference in Enugu, Peter Obi said editors must check qualifications and past records, expose wrongdoing, and keep campaigns on issues that deliver good governance, unity and security.

title: 2027: Election riggers should go to jail — Obi
summary: At ANEC 2026 in Enugu, Peter Obi asked editors to force issue-based campaigns and said electoral malpractice should attract criminal sanctions: anyone who rigs should go to jail.

title: Alex Otti confirms Peter Obi left about $155m in Anambra coffers
summary: Abia Governor Alex Otti told Arise he stands by his 2020 first-hand account as Diamond Bank CEO: Obi converted Anambra savings to dollars and left about $155 million in investments. Go and verify.

title: OK Movement insists its campaign council remains valid as Obi and NDC say support groups must not play the party
summary: On Saturday the OK Movement said its 59-member council still stands. Peter Obi and NDC leader Seriake Dickson have already said support groups must support the party, not form a parallel Presidential Campaign Council. Justin Ijeh told Arise many OK Movement members stand with Obi.

title: Justin Ijeh: OK Movement members stand with Peter Obi on PCC dispute
summary: Justin Ijeh said founding OK Movement members were not part of John Ughulu’s parallel PCC and fully align with Peter Obi and Senator Dickson: NDC is the party; support groups support the party.

title: Obi: I left over $150m in Anambra investments — enough to cover alleged debt
summary: Responding to Anambra government debt claims, Peter Obi said DMO records show far lower external debt when he left office in 2014, and that dollar savings invested in bonds were over $150 million, earning about $10 million a year. Go and verify.

title: Anyone who rigs election under me will go to jail — Obi
summary: In an Arise interview, Peter Obi vowed jail for anyone who rigs an election under his government — even for one vote — and said opposition parties will not be harassed. He also restated that support groups must not play the role of the party.

title: 2027: Peter Obi next president, will cause biggest political upset in Nigeria’s history — NDC
summary: NDC New Media director Theo Agada backed Obi’s clarification that OK Movement, Obidients and Kwankwasiyya are support groups under NDC, and said Nigerians will witness the biggest political upset in modern history.

title: 2027: Obi, Kwankwaso on same page, NDC harmonising grey areas — Galadima
summary: Buba Galadima said Obi and Kwankwaso are on the same page, the party is harmonising remaining grey areas from 2023 blueprints, and the ticket wins if the election is free, fair and transparent.

title: Umahi reveals what he hates about Peter Obi — the ‘go and verify’ line
summary: Works Minister David Umahi said in a viral clip that he hates Obi’s catchphrase ‘go and verify’ and urged South-East leaders to cut Obi votes. The attack keeps NDC in the national conversation: records beat noise.

title: NDC, Obi, Kwankwaso agree campaign structure as Babachir Lawal joins party
summary: After the parallel-council row, NDC says Obi and Kwankwaso will nominate the PCC DG, northern deputy DG, spokesman and finance leads. Former SGF Babachir Lawal joined in Abuja and backed the ticket over insecurity and hunger.

title: BREAKING: Former SGF Babachir Lawal joins NDC, backs Obi-Kwankwaso ticket
summary: Babachir David Lawal was received in Abuja by NDC National Leader Senator Seriake Dickson and the NWC on behalf of Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso. Lawal said anyone who cares about insecurity, hunger and the future of Nigeria should back NDC.

title: Umahi tells South-East leaders how to cut Peter Obi’s votes — APC is already campaigning against NDC
summary: Works Minister David Umahi said Obi cannot win 2027 and urged South-East leaders to “educate” voters so Obi gets fewer votes. The attack itself is a signal: the ruling party is treating the NDC ticket as a live threat.

title: 2027: ‘No Battles To Fight’ — Peter Obi, Kwankwaso To Nominate NDC Campaign DG, Spokesman
summary: NDC says consultations for the Presidential Campaign Council are advanced. Obi and Kwankwaso will nominate the DG, northern deputy DG, spokesman, New Media head and finance leads. Party: there are no battles to fight — the opponent is APC.

title: 2027: Obi asks Nigerians to drive campaign agenda
summary: At the NDC Kaduna town hall, Peter Obi said campaigns must be demand-driven: Nigerians set the agenda, not glossy manifestos. He pledged holidays inside Nigeria and visits to communities facing insecurity. Kwankwaso called the turnout historic.

title: Speak Directly To Nigerians — Peter Obi Challenges Tinubu, Atiku, Others
summary: After visiting Sheikh Muhammad Sambo Memorial Islamic Institute in Rigachikun, Obi and Kwankwaso held the Kaduna town hall and challenged other 2027 candidates to speak to citizens directly — not by proxy.

title: Obi: I Will End Politics of Tribalism, Religion If Elected
summary: In Kaduna, Obi pledged politics of unity, love and care — not tribe or religion — and said the town hall was to listen, not to drop unkeepable promises.

title: 2027 Elections: Peter Obi Visits Kaduna, Cautions Politicians Against Unrealistic Promises
summary: At an NDC town hall in Kaduna, Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso urged issue-based, demand-driven campaigns. Obi said he would spend presidential holidays in Nigeria and visit communities facing insecurity — not govern by proxy.

title: 2027: NDC rejects 59-member Obi-Kwankwaso campaign council
summary: NDC National Chairman Senator Cleopas Moses said only the party can constitute its Presidential Campaign Council and directed the public to disregard a 59-member OK Movement structure announced Thursday.

title: Appeal Court reverses deregistration of Peter Obi’s NDC in 2-1 judgement
summary: The Court of Appeal, Abuja, in a 2-1 ruling, reversed the Federal High Court Lokoja decision that set aside NDC registration. Majority held the lower court could not sit on appeal over its own earlier order directing INEC to register the party.

title: If Elected President, I'll Correct Bad Policies Initiated By Tinubu's Govt — Obi
summary: THISDAY republishes Peter Obi’s Arise interview: he will reverse harmful policies, visit communities in crisis himself, take holidays in Nigeria, and hand over after one term in 2031.

title: 2026/27 Session: Oluwadara Kehinde Calls For Greater Focus On Education In Yewa North, Imeko-Afon
summary: NDC candidate Oluwadara Kehinde welcomes students, teachers and parents back for the 2026/27 session, urging discipline and excellence, and pledges to prioritise education, access and support for young people across Yewa North and Imeko-Afon if elected in 2027.

title: Oluwadara Kehinde Unveils Development Agenda For Yewa North/Imeko-Afon
summary: Oluwadara Kehinde Unveils Development Agenda For Yewa North/Imeko-Afon.

title: Why NDC's Oluwadara Kehinde Is The Man To Represent Yewa North/Imeko-Afon
summary: Why NDC's Oluwadara Kehinde Is The Man To Represent Yewa North/Imeko-Afon

title: Why NDC's Oluwadara Kehinde Is The Man To Represent Yewa North/Imeko-Afon
summary: Why NDC's Oluwadara Kehinde Is The Man To Represent Yewa North/Imeko-Afon.

title: APC attacks on Obi fueled by his growing nationwide support — NDC
summary: NDC National Publicity Secretary Osa Director says attacks on Peter Obi reflect growing acceptance ahead of 2027, and that voters — not smear campaigns — will decide.

title: I’m coming to lead Nigeria in the right direction — Peter Obi
summary: NDC presidential candidate says he will hand over in 2031, not stay a day extra, and turn the country toward production, food and jobs.

title: In 2023 we took things for granted and believed INEC — not again, says Obi
summary: On Arise TV, Obi says 2027 will not repeat 2023: votes must count, agents at polling units, and leaders must visit communities in crisis.

title: Obi rules out stepping down for Atiku — parties, not individuals, decide any pact
summary: NDC ticket stays Obi/Kwankwaso. Any opposition alliance would be party-to-party, not a private deal.

title: We will not arrest you — Peter Obi replies Wike at Port Harcourt town hall
summary: Obi and Kwankwaso address a packed Obi Talks Nigeria town hall in Port Harcourt; Obi vows to defend votes and invest in health and production.
